items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. Define the exact conditional reference law q_y=volume.tilted(r↦−V(r)−‖r−y‖²/(2η)); tilted denotes the normalized exponential tilt with its literal totalized Mathlib definition. Let γ=N(0,I) be the standard Gaussian momentum law on E, and M_y=(q_y⊗γ)⊗P on ((reference,momentum),clock sample). Let tπ=π as a nonnegative finite time. The same jointly measurable phase witness Z additionally has the following properties. There exists a probability kernel R:E→Measure(E), jointly measurable in its parameter y, with R(y)=q_y for every y. There exists a probability kernel H:(E×E)→Measure(E), jointly measurable in the input (y,x), such that for every deterministic y,x, H(y,x) is exactly the pushforward of M_y by w↦firstCoordinate(Z(y,w.reference,(x,w.momentum),π,w.clock)). Thus H is the ideal exact-reference Algorithm1 returned-position kernel; q_y normalization and kernel measurability are conclusions, not assumptions. The phase pushforward at time zero is δ_x⊗γ. Moreover, for each fixed y,x, M_y-almost every w simultaneously satisfies Z(y,w.reference,(x,w.momentum),0,w.clock)=(x,w.momentum) and admits an actual finite live record a=(s,z) and index n at π with T_n≤π<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤π, π−s<τ(z,ε_n), and Z(y,w.reference,(x,w.momentum),π,w.clock)=Φ_(π−s)(z). The reference is independent of momentum and clocks under precisely the displayed product law and stays fixed along each run. This bounded ASTIS completion of source AppendixA.1 ideal H_y supplies a mathematical probability kernel and physical initialization/terminal agreement. It does not supply an implementable exact reference sampler, approximate reference comparison, expected cost, a phase Markov process or semigroup, invariance, reversibility, hypocoercivity, a random all-time path-law theorem, or a separately proved version-uniqueness theorem. There is no new hypothesis, correlated random-parameter substitution, uniform AE event over parameters or main/composition completion.
assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, including dimension zero. V is real-valued and C²; α,β are nonnegative reals.
Exactly six analytic source hypotheses: α>0; α≤β; V∈C²; for all x,v, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖²; η>0; βη≤1. No third or higher derivative bound.

Standing E,V,α,β,η are fixed. y,xRef,z0,t,sample are arguments of one jointly Borel map. P and ε are literal canonical definitions; measurability, positive support, recurrence, cover and nonaccumulation are produced dependencies.

Standing parameters are fixed. Actual80 deterministic covered-arc/fallback and per-fixedparams common-AE all-time phase properties are retained. The new origin/terminal assertions use the exact independent product M_y=(q_y⊗γ)⊗P, for each fixed y,x; no arbitrary correlated input or uniform event is inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. The initial-phase fallback is an explicitly labelled ASTIS measurable extension only on the uncovered complement; zero-time exceptional bounces need not have source index0 at t0.

q_y and R are constructed from the original six conditions, not extra measure, normalization, kernel or sampler premises. The standard Gaussian momentum is unscaled; η appears in the literal dynamics. Kernel input order is (y,x), corresponding to source fixed parameter y and starting position x.
